objective: Tune a DAB converter over UART while preserving raw evidence and comparing SPS, EPS, TPS, and AUTO control concepts.

firmware.application_auto_trip: disabled for the explicitly authorized manual-stop test build

telemetry_units.plimit_label_w: open-loop command label, not independently measured power

provenance_and_trust.raw_uart: Primary evidence for commands, firmware state, and firmware ADC telemetry.
provenance_and_trust.meter_annotations: Independent user-reported physical measurements; use as sparse labels.
provenance_and_trust.firmware_vout: Tracks the external meter but read approximately 0.45 V low near the 35.6 V operating point.
provenance_and_trust.firmware_power: Derived from firmware ADC channels; not an independent efficiency measurement.
provenance_and_trust.simulation: Model evidence only; never label it as physical validation.

known_control_issue.status: confirmed by static audit; not yet corrected or physically revalidated
known_control_issue.description: EPS/TPS inner shifts change pulse centers without compensating raw outer phase. Effective power phase is outer + sec_inner/2 - pri_inner/2. Current EPS/TPS/AUTO must not be used for powered tests until fixed.
